thread.title: What's the Ideal Price for Amazon?

title: What's the Ideal Price for Amazon?
text:
What's the Ideal Price for Amazon? By Ed Ponsi | Jan 19, 2018 | 10:00 AM EST 
Earlier this week, Apple (AAPL) announced that it would repatriate $245 billion that it currently holds overseas. The company also announced that it would create 20,000 jobs, build a second U.S. campus, and 'contribute' $350 billion to the U.S. economy over the next five years. The stock responded by breaking out of its range-bound doldrums and rocketing to an all-time closing high. 
A performance like that makes one wonder which other U.S. companies could benefit by repatriating funds to the U.S. For example, Amazon (AMZN) has an overseas cash hoard of $26 billion. Like Apple, Amazon is planning to build a second major campus, often referred to as HQ2. Repatriated funds could be used to help fund that project....345
